tool.name: nf-core annosine
tool.description: Accelerating de novo SINE annotation in plant and animal genomes
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ AnnoSINE_v2 \\ ${args} \\ --threads ${task.cpus} \\ ${mode} \\ ${fasta} \\ ${prefix} \\ &> >(tee ${prefix}.log 2>&1)
mv \\ ${prefix}/Seed_SINE.fa \\ ${prefix}.fa \\ || echo 'AnnoSINE_v2 did not find SINE sequences. See log for details!'
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": annosine: ${VERSION} END_VERSIONS ]]>
